final: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(games) as all_games FROM home_game), avg_games AS (SELECT AVG(games) as avg_games_value FROM home_game) SELECT t.team_id, t.total_games, CAST(t.total_games AS FLOAT) / gt.all_games as fraction, CAST(t.total_games AS FLOAT) / ag.avg_games_value as ratio FROM team_totals t CROSS JOIN grand_total gt CROSS JOIN avg_games ag ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
